rows.text: In the House of Representatives plenary on 10 April 2000, 森喜朗 (printed ○内閣総理大臣（森喜朗君）), answering on the LDP's future, says that he had assisted 小渕前総裁 as LDP secretary-general on party reform, and that as LDP president too (自由民主党総裁としても) he will carry out party reform.
